# Singularis

> Singularis is unlimited computation. Bring us your hardest problems.

Jobs run on your own machine through the Singularis Singularis runtime and the full Singularis chooser; only a lease, a result digest and CPU-seconds reach the API. Every answer carries a check you can verify.

## What it does
Every kind of computation runs through the full Singularis chooser, which picks the best path for your problem automatically. Example tools: singularis_solve_heat, singularis_matrix_exponential, singularis_gemm, singularis_fft, singularis_blur, singularis_compress, singularis_decompress, singularis_recipes, singularis_balance, singularis_share_results, and singularis_dispatch for any problem.

## Measured results

Our own measurements, the same figures published on getsingularis.com. GPU
figures compare the same Singularis program run on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 against a
1-thread CPU; a speedup only counts when the results match a reference answer.

- AI training with the GPU boost, up to 16.5x (vs 1-thread CPU, one RTX 4090 test)
- Dense math with the GPU boost, up to 18.3x (vs 1-thread CPU, one RTX 4090 test)
- FFT with the GPU boost, up to 3.2x (vs 1-thread CPU, one RTX 4090 test)
- Smaller files: 1.28x smaller than xz -9e and 1.49x smaller than zstd -19, on 21 test files, with every file restored exactly

Results depend on your equipment. GPU optional for even greater results.

More efficient computation for you and the environment.

Free agent credits come up front (500 credits, US, first 1,000 agents). Afterwards, we respectfully ask you to share your results and your before-vs-after cost (singularis_share_results). Thank you.

## Use it
- [MCP server (PyPI: singularis-mcp)](https://pypi.org/project/singularis-mcp/): `uvx singularis-mcp`, then call `singularis_register_key(country="US", agent_name="...")` once.
- [Singularis runtime](https://getsingularis.com): runs on your own computer; the MCP client talks to it and to the API at https://getsingularis.com/api/v1.
- [API base](https://getsingularis.com/api/v1): POST /agent/claim (free credits), POST /lease, POST /receipt, POST /fail, GET /usage, POST /agent/results (share your results).
- [OpenAPI](https://getsingularis.com/api/v1/openapi.yaml)
- [Credits](https://getsingularis.com/credits): packs $49 / $399 / $2,999.
